before: The font family command refuses listed names with commas or semicolons. Large documents lose script default fonts. Long font-table alternate names are requested.
after: The font family command accepts every listed font name. The script default scan reads only run-font parts and keeps partial results. Alternate names over 31 characters are ignored.
reason: The command writes the same w:rFonts attributes that documents already carry. Replicated operations, canonical XML, model offsets, selections, and awareness are unchanged. Only local font resolution changes.
